args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, a mix of relief and concern for the economy.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — A cozy, alpine-inspired restaurant in the heart of the city serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, hearty rösti, chocolate fondue). Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I just took a look at your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's clean and straightforward — a nice personal touch to have a simple space that introduces you and shares your contact details. A couple of ideas that could make it even better: adding a short bio or a few interests would give visitors a bit more to connect with, and some links to your other work or projects would make it more useful. Overall, a solid, welcoming personal site!

Hi Eve! I had a look at your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that it centers on hiking — it's a great theme, and it makes the blog feel personal and genuine. One suggestion: adding a few photos from your hikes and maybe a short write-up of your favorite trails would bring the site to life and give readers something to come back for. Thanks for sharing it — looking forward to reading more!
